description:
Read current orders through a saved broker connection, or request cancellation/modification of one exact owned order. Management always requires a fresh website approval and never places a replacement trade. Read the returned broker state after execution; a pending cancellation is not a canceled order.

Set "action" to choose the operation. Only send the fields listed for that action.

## action="list": Get broker orders
No other fields required.
Read-only: fetches current or recent broker orders directly from a saved broker credential. Use symbol, statuses, startTimeIso, and endTimeIso to narrow. Never pass raw broker credentials.

## action="manage": Cancel or modify an existing broker order
Required fields: brokerCredentialId, orderId, operation, reason.
HIGH RISK: request website approval to cancel or modify one exact order on a saved broker connection. Read current broker orders first and copy the native orderId and selected brokerCredentialId. The server binds the returned contract and side. operation=cancel takes no changes. operation=modify takes changes.limitPrice, stopPrice and/or quantity; quantity means the new total including fills already received, when the broker supports it. Use only changes the user requested and provide a reason of at least 200 characters explaining the action, evidence and remaining risk. Reuse the same idempotencyKey for a retry of the same request. A pending approval or completed worker is not proof of cancellation or a fill. After approval check the action status and refresh broker orders; fills can win cancellation races. Never place a replacement trade to emulate modification. For Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other clients without BotSpot native confirmation cards, return the exact authorizationUrl as a clickable Markdown link in your reply. Do not say a card or button was created unless the client actually rendered it. BotSpot clients may render structuredContent as a native confirmation, but a button name alone is not an approval link. A pending request is not execution; only the signed-in user may approve on the website. Report expiry and check get_deployment_action_status after approval.

action.description: Which operation to run: "list", "manage". See the tool description for each one.

brokerCredentialId.description: Used with action="list", action="manage". Required for action="manage".

operation.description: Used with action="manage". Required for action="manage".

orderId.description: Used with action="manage". Required for action="manage".

outcome.description: Selected prediction contract outcome; Kalshi uses yes or no. Used with action="list".

reason.description: Required explicit trade explanation: at least 200 Unicode characters; prefer 600–2,500 covering intent, evidence and material risks. Maximum 100,000 characters and 400 KiB UTF-8. Do not include credentials or hidden chain of thought. Used with action="manage". Required for action="manage".
